en: The advice could scarcely be heard in the din.
context: The advice could scarcely be heard in the din.
meaning: 劝告淹没在一片喧嚣中，几乎没人听得见
current_zh: 但在一片喧腾中，这些劝告根本无人理会。
suggest: 这些劝告淹没在一片喧嚣之中，几乎没人听得见
alt: 在一片喧嚣中几乎无人听见
note: 原文说“听不见”（heard），现译改成“无人理会”（heeded），意思偏了；“淹没”比喻贴切。

context: Within the Social Revolutionary party, a schism opened between the “responsible” national leadership and the village committees.
current_zh: 社会革命党内部也因此出现分裂，“负责任”的全国领导层与村庄委员会走向分裂。
suggest: 社会革命党内，全国领导层与村委员会之间裂开了一道口子
note: 现译一句里两个“分裂”，重复；“裂痕”贴切。引号用法见讽刺表。

context: The party adopted en bloc the programme of the national Congress of Peasant Soviets (19 August 1917) as its own
current_zh: 最后，布尔什维克整体接受了 1917 年 8 月 19 日全国农民苏维埃代表大会的纲领
suggest: 照单全收
note: 照单全收略口语、中性，贴 en bloc；现译“最后”是增译。

context: but it was the programme of the peasantry, and must be wholeheartedly embraced by the party if the workers’ revolution was to succeed.
current_zh: 可既然它是农民自己的纲领，工人革命若要成功，党就必须毫无保留地拥抱它。
suggest: 党就必须真心实意地接受它
note: “拥抱”是翻译腔。“全心全意”易让人联想“为人民服务”，场景在俄国，宜用“真心实意”。

en: on the face of it, a clean sweep
context: It was, on the face of it, a clean sweep of landlord power. But the “cleanness” depended upon the application of the classification used in the bill
meaning: 表面上把地主势力一扫而光
current_zh: 表面上看，这好像是对地主权力的彻底扫除。
suggest: 乍看之下，地主势力被一扫而光
note: 下句用加引号的 cleanness 回扣，译文须留一个能回扣的字（如“干净”“彻底”），否则讽刺落空；回扣的反讽见讽刺表同页条。

context: For those unfortunate enough to be classed as “landlord”, there were escape routes.
current_zh: 即便不幸被划为“地主”，也并非完全没有出路。
suggest: 退路
note: “出路”偏指前途，“退路”更贴 escape；现译“并非完全没有”削弱了原文的肯定语气。unfortunate 的反语见讽刺表。

en: lest the bitterness of decades explode and engulf the party
context: To cope with the demand, the party had to be vastly expanded, and, wherever possible, backed by military or public security forces lest the bitterness of decades explode and engulf the party in a “peasant war”.
meaning: 几十年的积怨一旦爆发，会把党也卷进去吞没
current_zh: 以防农民多年来积累的怨恨突然爆炸，把党也一并卷入真正的“农民战争”。
suggest: 以防几十年的积怨一朝爆发，把党也卷进一场“农民战争”
note: “多年来”弱于 decades；“真正的”是增译；“怨恨爆炸”搭配生硬，“积怨爆发”自然。

en: the regulations were diluted to mollify the landlords
context: In south Jiangsu, the regulations were diluted to mollify the landlords
meaning: 为安抚地主，条例被打了折扣
current_zh: 比如在苏南，政策就被显著软化
suggest: 在苏南，为了安抚地主，条例打了折扣
note: 现译漏了 to mollify the landlords，又添“显著”；“打折扣”贴切中性。

en: The strong mixture of revolution had become very dilute
context: The strong mixture of revolution had become very dilute by the time it reached the villages.
meaning: 革命这剂烈性药酒传到村里时已兑得很淡
current_zh: 革命这剂烈药，到了村庄已被冲淡得几乎无味。
suggest: 革命这剂猛药，到了村里已经兑得很稀了
alt: 革命这碗烈酒，传到村里已掺了不少水
note: mixture 可解为药或酒，“烈药”可取；“几乎无味”是增译，very dilute 只说很淡。

context: From there, the party raised its sights to the “lower level” co-operatives, covering about 100 households
current_zh: 接着，党又把目标提高到“初级合作社”
suggest: 接着，党又把眼光放高，瞄准了“初级社”
note: 现译平实可用；不用“更上一层楼”（褒义，违背作者语气）。

context: The cadres were to brook no resistance; all opposition was now denounced as “Rightist”
current_zh: 干部们不准再容忍任何反对
suggest: 干部容不得半点抵制
note: brook 是书面古语，“容不得半点”力度相当；现译“不准再容忍”拗口。

en: The ink was barely dry on the new land deeds
context: The ink was barely dry on the new land deeds before the fluctuation in the agricultural economy and the high demand for foodstuffs from the cities ... began to drive the poor marginal cultivators out of production
current_zh: 新土地证上的墨迹尚未干透
suggest: 新地契墨迹未干
note: 中英比喻同构，“墨迹未干”是现成说法；“地契”比“土地证”更贴 deeds 也更口语（当时正式名称为土地房产所有证，两者皆可）。

context: Nineteen fifty-six saw another tide of complaints against food shortages, the privileged position of the cities, the petty tyranny of the cadres and the depredations involved in co-operativization.
current_zh: 1956 年，农村再次出现大量关于粮食短缺、城市享有特权、干部的专横以及合作化过程中的掠夺的抱怨。
suggest: 1956年又是一片怨声：
note: “怨声载道”语气偏重（遍地都是），可作备选；现译“关于……的抱怨”定语过长，宜拆成“又是一片怨声：粮食短缺……”。

en: the petty tyranny of the cadres
context: Nineteen fifty-six saw another tide of complaints against food shortages, the privileged position of the cities, the petty tyranny of the cadres and the depredations involved in co-operativization.
meaning: 基层干部在小范围内专横跋扈
current_zh: 干部的专横
suggest: 干部作威作福
note: “作威作福”贴 petty tyranny，贬义相当；不宜用“土皇帝”（过口语、加重）。

en: the eloquent language of the stomach confounded the statistics
context: Yet the eloquent language of the stomach confounded the statistics.
meaning: 饥饿的事实比统计更有说服力，驳倒了统计
current_zh: 可肚子里的饥饿感比统计数字更有说服力。
suggest: 可饿着的肚子比统计数字更会说话
alt: 空肚子雄辩地驳倒了统计数字
note: 保留拟人修辞；现译“饥饿感”略平；confounded 有“驳倒、使之难堪”之意。

context: The veto on worker and peasant participation could not be upheld in the cities in the heady days of 1966 and 1967
meaning: 群情激昂、令人陶醉的那段日子
current_zh: 1966 年和 1967 年运动高涨时
suggest: 在1966、1967年那段狂热的日子里
note: heady 中性偏褒，“狂热”略带贬义，“如火如荼”中性偏褒；现译“运动高涨时”也可用。

context: Some villages held meetings, and the local capitalist roaders received a drubbing.
current_zh: 某些村庄还召开过会议，当地“走资派”干部也挨了斗。
suggest: 当地的走资派挨了一顿批斗
note: “挨斗”是现成说法，贴切；drubbing 口语，力度相当。

context: The short swing to the “Right” from 1969 produced an affirmation that private agriculture, the right to raise livestock and practise “sideline” activities ... were inviolable rights of the rural population.
current_zh: 1969 年以后那段向“右”的短期摆动
suggest: 1969年起政策一度向“右”摆
note: “摆动”可保留，与下文 the subsequent swing “Left” 对应；“短期摆动”略生硬。

context: For the régime, the peasants were the scapegoats of China.
current_zh: 对政权来说，农民始终是中国各种困境的方便替罪羊。
suggest: 在政权眼里，农民是中国的替罪羊
note: 中英同构；现译“始终”“方便”“各种困境”均为增译，宜删。

context: The peasants refused to relinquish the products of the soil. Then State policy went into reverse, permitting the restoration of the “rich peasant economy”.
meaning: 政策掉头，朝相反方向退
current_zh: 于是国家政策只好反复后退，允许“富农经济”恢复。
suggest: 国家政策随即掉转方向
note: 现译“反复”与下文 zigzags 混同，是增译；不用“开倒车”（贬义方向不对）。

context: When that threatened the rural authority, the State swung back towards stricter administration, and so on, an endless series of zigzags to escape from the imperatives of backwardness and build a powerful national economy.
current_zh: 国家就这样来回折腾，企图摆脱落后所强加的约束，建立强大的民族经济。
suggest: 如此循环往复，左右摇摆，没完没了
note: “折腾”口语、略贬，可用；现译漏了 endless（没完没了）。

en: were bribed to ignore such activities
context: in some cases, work brigades were bribed to ignore such activities, and rents secretly continued to be collected.
current_zh: 有些工作队甚至被贿赂而装作没看见
suggest: 有些工作队收了好处，便睁一只眼闭一只眼
note: 俗语正合 ignore，口语但不油滑；现译“甚至”是增译。

context: The party centre might forbid the rural cadres to hire labour, rent out land or lend money, but to no avail.
current_zh: 中央当然可以命令乡村干部不准雇工、不准出租土地、不准放高利贷，但这些禁令毫无作用。
suggest: 禁令形同虚设
note: “形同虚设”贴切，力度相当；现译“放高利贷”是增译，原文 lend money 只是放贷。

context: But in general, the mass of the rural population remained onlookers, the recipients of reforms (such as improved rural medical services) rather than the initiators.
current_zh: 可总体而言，绝大多数农村人口都只是接受改革的人，例如改善农村医疗，而不是发起改革的人。
suggest: 大多数农民始终是旁观者
note: 现译漏了 remained onlookers，应补。“看客”有鲁迅式冷意，可能稍重；不用“袖手旁观”“作壁上观”（含主动不管之意）。

en: It was the same as the problem of wage differentials.
context: It was the same as the problem of wage differentials.
meaning: 与工资差别问题一模一样
current_zh: 这与工资差别问题如出一辙。
suggest: 如出一辙
note: 现译已用，贴切。
